notes: Interactive frequency tuning on the Tuning page. Build a frequency sweep (start/end/step), and for each frequency: Show frequency screen (navigates the 4D panel so you set it), then Run point - the app reads the electrode temp, fires plasma for the plasma time while tracking peak wattage, reads the temp again (delta-T), logs the row, and cools - then steps to the next frequency. Live editable sweep table, delta-T-vs-frequency and wattage-vs-frequency charts, recommended frequency (max heating), and Export report CSV. Plasma ON/OFF buttons and a big E-STOP that cuts plasma and pump (and aborts the Opta) immediately.
